source.check: Mid-Ulster Mail 20 May 1961 p1 'County and Rural Council Nominations', read in the page image: 'There are to be no contests for the other 25 seats on the Council. No one was nominated for Draperstown'; three new members and 'the other unopposed candidates, with divisions they represent in parentheses'.

note: Triennial election of Magherafelt Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Only Castledawson was contested: Mr. Hugh M'Master, who had represented the division for more than thirty years as an official Unionist, stood after Mr. Samuel K. Dunlop was chosen as the Unionist candidate, and beat Dunlop by 76 votes. Twenty-four divisions were filled unopposed (Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1961, p. 1). No one was nominated for Draperstown (retiring member Patrick Trolan), so that seat was not filled at the election and is not recorded here. Returned unopposed.
